summary: 周六。pochenai 提交 EIP-8130 修正，防止两个交易数据相同的 EOA 复用同一个 payer 签名耗尽 payer 的 gas 存款。ethresear.ch 分析 EIP-7999 的“通用溢出”方案，在多维费用市场中保留 CALL 周围的旧式标量 gas 预留模式。BrianBland 提出使用二维 nonce 的 ERC-20 转账授权方案。

items.topic: 原生 AA：EIP-8130 payer 签名重放
items.title: EIP-8130：防止跨发送者的 payer 签名重放
items.note: （pochenai）提交：payer 签名哈希包含 from 字段，但规范没说明 EOA 路径下 from 为空时填什么；若编码为空，两个交易数据相同的 EOA 会得到同一 payer 哈希，第二个 EOA 可复用签名耗尽 payer 的 gas 存款，因此要求用恢复出的发送者地址填入。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: prevent cross sender payer signature replay
items.note_en: (pochenai), submitted: the payer signature hash includes a from field, but the spec did not say what goes there on the EOA path where from is empty; encoded as empty, two EOAs with identical transaction data would share a payer hash, letting the second reuse the signature and drain the payer's gas deposit, so the recovered sender address must be substituted.
items.topic_en: Native AA: EIP-8130 payer signature replay

items.topic: 交易与 gas：多维费用市场的 gas 溢出
items.title: ethresear.ch：多维费用市场的 gas 溢出
items.note: 00:42：分析 EIP-7999 的“通用溢出”，作为在 CALL 周围保留旧式标量 gas 预留模式的最小方案，同时避免把所有 EVM gas 都按最贵资源定价；文中致谢 Vitalik 提供主要思路。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Gas overflow for multidimensional fee markets
items.note_en: 00:42: analyzes "universal overflow" for EIP-7999 as a minimal way to keep the legacy scalar retained gas pattern around CALL while avoiding pricing all EVM gas at the most expensive resource; it credits Vitalik for the main idea.
items.topic_en: Transactions and gas: gas overflow in multidimensional fee markets

items.title: 新增 ERC：Keyed Transfer With Authorization
items.note: （BrianBland）提交：ERC-20 转账授权采用 (uint192 nonceKey, uint64 nonceSequence) 拆分，沿用 ERC-4337 的半抽象 nonce 编码，让重复付款给同一对象时每个 (payer, key) 只占一个存储槽。
items.title_en: Add ERC: Keyed Transfer With Authorization
items.note_en: (BrianBland), submitted: ERC-20 transfer authorizations split nonces into (uint192 nonceKey, uint64 nonceSequence), mirroring ERC-4337's semi abstracted encoding, so repeat payments to one counterparty use one storage slot per (payer, key).

summary_en: A Saturday. pochenai submitted an EIP-8130 fix so two EOAs with identical transaction data cannot reuse one payer signature and drain the payer's gas deposit. ethresear.ch analyzed "universal overflow" for EIP-7999, keeping the legacy scalar gas retention pattern around CALL in a multidimensional fee market. BrianBland proposed an ERC-20 transfer authorization scheme using 2D nonces.
